item.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
item.description: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press

item.title: How to talk AI around the Thanksgiving table
item.description: You're gathered with family this Thanksgiving when the topic of AI comes up. How can you have a productive, fact-based conversation?
item.dc:creator: Kevin Roose

item.title: What to know before using AI agents for Black Friday shopping
item.description: 59% of U.S. shoppers plan to use AI for holiday shopping this weekend, according to the National Retail Federation
item.dc:creator: Stephan Bisaha

item.title: Buying new things feels wonderful. But it can also be a trap
item.description: Constantly buying new things can be problematic, says journalist Eric Athas, author of the new book "Saying No to New." Here's how to break the cycle and find joy in what you already have.
item.dc:creator: Andee Tagle

item.title: How high technology is changing cargo crime
item.description: Truckloads of turkey and bourbon are getting stolen in transit. Cargo theft of food and beverages are on the rise in part because the goods are hard to trace. We look at how high technology is changing cargo crime.
item.dc:creator: Sarah Gonzalez
